This is a REAL, notable asymmetry from Sheet's own citations: radix-ui IS vendored in this clone (primitives/, used for Sheet's/Dialog's own [S] behaviour citations) but vaul is NOT, so every Drawer behaviour row this column cannot read directly in Drawer.tsx's own JSX is marked [R], not [S] — a structurally weaker evidence base than this pipeline's other overlay columns, and declared as such rather than silently upgraded. apps/v4/registry/new-york-v4/ui/sheet.tsx read ONLY to fix the drawer-vs-sheet scope boundary (see docs/DRAWER-MATRIX.md scope note) — NOT a style/structure source for this row.
provenance.surface / border-base / muted-bg / muted: the SAME slots dialog.shadcn.json already resolves (bg-background, --border, bg-muted, text-muted-foreground, text-foreground) — reused verbatim because DrawerContent/DrawerHeader/DrawerFooter/DrawerTitle/DrawerDescription reference the identical CSS custom properties.
provenance.scrim-bg: DrawerOverlay className: bg-black/50 -> color-mix(in oklab, #000 50%, transparent), the identical rule dialog.shadcn.json's own scrim resolves (DrawerOverlay's whole className string is byte-identical to SheetOverlay's and DialogOverlay's).
provenance.radius-panel: --radius-lg -> --radius = 0.625rem, the SAME slot dialog.shadcn.json's own panel shape resolves — used here ONLY at the far corners of top/bottom drawers (rounded-b-lg / rounded-t-lg); left/right drawers have no border-radius class of any kind.
provenance.no-panel-shadow: CONFIRMED ABSENCE: DrawerContent's own className string — read in full, twice — has no shadow-* utility of any kind, unlike Dialog's own shadow-lg and Sheet's own shadow-lg. A real, sourced contrast between this sibling and its own siblings.
provenance.no-close-default: CONFIRMED ABSENCE: drawer.tsx declares `DrawerClose` with NO className at all — a bare wrapper around DrawerPrimitive.Close (vaul), unlike DialogContent's own default-rendered, pre-styled corner X and SheetContent's own showCloseButton=true default. drawer-demo.tsx's own real usage places a DrawerClose INSIDE DrawerFooter as a full <Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button>, not a corner glyph.
provenance.asymmetric-duration: DrawerContent className: `data-[state=closed]:duration-300 data-[state=open]:duration-500` — the drawer opens over 500ms and closes over 300ms, a deliberate asymmetry neither Dialog nor Sheet's own className strings carry (both leave duration unset/default). See docs/DRAWER-MATRIX.md Finding 3.
provenance.drag-handle: DrawerContent's own literal child: `<div className="mx-auto mt-4 hidden h-2 w-[100px] shrink-0 rounded-full bg-muted group-data-[vaul-drawer-direction=bottom]/drawer-content:block" />` — hidden by default, shown ONLY when the group's own direction data attribute is "bottom".
